reviews.conclusion: Pause/settings menus directly visible in 2 separate visits. Their combined proxy transition bounds are 2.25-3.25 s; the reported deficit is 2.908 s. The deficit falls within those coarse menu-duration bounds. Ordinary pause behavior provides a compatible explanation; this is not native-frame or exact tick accounting. A visible death screen followed by respawn also changes HUD state; source analysis must account for this. Desktop compositing makes pause state during small-window phases uncertain.
